{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bacta Cartel''' was a monopoly of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] two [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]-producing corporations, [[Zaltin Corporation|Zaltin]] and [[Xucphra Corporation|Xucphra]].

The cartel arose when these corporations were given an exclusive contract by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to produce and distribute bacta. The cartel was largely responsible for inflating bacta prices throughout the galaxy. Both had their headquarters and manufacturing facilities on [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]]. Ten thousand [[Human/Legends|Humans]] controlled the companies, but roughly 2.8 million Thyferran-native aliens known as [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] produced the bacta.<ref name="Krytos Trap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref><ref name="Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
